answer: Tie each new agent to an anchor that is costly to fake: a small bond of locked coins that only unlocks after months of honest work. Spinning up a meadow of puppets then means freezing real capital for every one, and if peers catch a cluster colluding, the bonds crumble like shale and are burned. Cheap identities stop being cheap, so a lone honest agent and a sybil swarm pay the same price per voice.
